jurisdiction: Global (Whole world)

HL7 2021

Destinations

-IndexProfile
*1Test script profile destination type: FHIR-Server (FHIR Server)

variable

name: rdsResourceId

defaultValue: 2535717

description: Enter the resource ID of the Observation describing a Radiation Dose Summary, registered in your server.

variable

name: patientId

expression: Observation.subject.reference.replaceMatches('.*Patient/','').replaceMatches('/_history.*','')

sourceId: rds-read-response

variable

name: deviceId

expression: Observation.device.reference.replaceMatches('.*Device/','').replaceMatches('/_history.*','')

sourceId: rds-read-response

variable

name: practitionerId

expression: Observation.performer.reference.replaceMatches('.*Practitioner/','').replaceMatches('/_history.*','')

sourceId: rds-read-response

variable

name: imagingStudyId

expression: Observation.partOf.reference.replaceMatches('.*(MedicationAdministration|MedicationDispense|MedicationStatement|Procedure|Immunization|ImagingStudy)/','').replaceMatches('/_history.*','')

sourceId: rds-read-response

variable

name: date

path: Observation/effectiveDateTime/@value

sourceId: rds-read-response

variable

name: identifier

path: Observation/identifier/value

sourceId: rds-read-response

test

name: Observation_read

description: Read provided Observation - the radiation dose summary

action

Operations

-TypeResourceDescriptionAcceptEncodeRequestUrlParamsResponseId
*Test script operation code: read (Read)ObservationRead the Radiation Dose Summary observation ${rdsResourceId}jsontrue/${rdsResourceId}rds-read-response

action

Asserts

-DescriptionDirectionOperatorResponseCodeWarningOnly
*Confirm that the returned HTTP status is 200(OK) or 201(Created).responsein200,201false

action

Asserts

-DescriptionDirectionOperatorPathWarningOnly
*Confirm that the returned Observation is not empty.responsenotEmptyObservation/idfalse

name: Observation_search_patient

description: Search radiation dose summary by patient

action

action

Asserts

-DescriptionExpressionWarningOnly
*Confirm that the total number of response is greater than 1.Bundle.total.toInteger() >= 1false

name: TestScript_RDSC_Simulator
description: TestScript to validate the FHIR Server searching capabilities.

variable.name: rdsResourceId
variable.description: Enter the resource ID of the Observation describing a Radiation Dose Summary, registered in your server. Read from the response of the autocreated RDS transaction; defaultValue is the fallback.

test.name: Observation_read
test.description: Read provided Observation - the radiation dose summary

operation.description: Read the Radiation Dose Summary observation ${rdsResourceId}

assert.description: Confirm that the returned HTTP status is 200(OK) or 201(Created).
Confirm that the returned Observation is not empty.

test.name: Observation_search_patient
test.description: Search radiation dose summary by patient

operation.description: Search Radiation Dose Summary using the patientId ${patientId}

assert.description: Confirm that the total number of response is greater than 1.

test.name: Observation_search_device
test.description: Search radiation dose summary by device

operation.description: Search Radiation Dose Summary using the deviceId ${deviceId}

assert.description: Confirm that the total number of response is greater than 1.

test.name: Observation_search_partof
test.description: Search radiation dose summary by part-of

operation.description: Search Radiation Dose Summary using the ImagingStudy ID ${imagingStudyId}

assert.description: Confirm that the total number of response is greater than 1.

test.name: Observation_search_identifier
test.description: Search radiation dose summary by identifier

operation.description: Search Radiation Dose Summary using the identifier of the Observation ${identifier}

assert.description: Confirm that the total number of response is greater than 1.

test.name: Observation_search_date
test.description: Search radiation dose summary by date

operation.description: Search Radiation Dose Summary using the date of the Observation ${date}

assert.description: Confirm that the total number of response is greater than 1.
Confirm that the returned HTTP status is 200(OK) or 201(Created).
Confirm that the returned Patient is not empty.
Confirm that the returned HTTP status is 200(OK) or 201(Created).
Confirm that the returned Device is not empty.
Confirm that the returned HTTP status is 200(OK) or 201(Created).
Confirm that the returned Practitioner is not empty.
Confirm that the returned HTTP status is 200(OK) or 201(Created).
Confirm that the returned ImagingStudy is not empty.
